train_video_classification_model: train a PyTorchVideo ResNet model on the Kinetics dataset using PyTorch Lightning
create_video_classification_lightning_mo: create a LightningModule that constructs a video or audio ResNet model with cross-entropy loss
build_kinetics_data_module: build a LightningDataModule that creates train and val dataloaders for the Kinetics dataset
run_video_transforms: run video preprocessing transforms including temporal subsample, normalize, random scale, crop, and horizontal flip
run_audio_transforms: run audio preprocessing transforms including resample, mel spectrogram, log transform, and temporal subsample
